capture_source.note: Integrated source the captures were rendered from; never the commit that records them.

renderer.capture_method: SubViewport native render, read back with get_texture().get_image()
renderer.determinism: Run with --fixed-fps 60 so the shipped camera-shake tween is sampled at a fixed delta.

presentation_modes.description: Shipped presentation with the screen_shake accessibility toggle on and three live hazards.
Same beats with the weapon's declared crowd cap of live hazards, so the shipped victim-impact pool runs at capacity.
Shipped reduced-motion path: the screen_shake toggle is off, so SniperUltimatePresentationScene never binds a camera and the frame stays centred.
Screen shake off and the per-beat backdrop alpha recorded; the Sniper treatment is a single monotone step per phase, so it carries no repeating full-screen flash.

scene_configuration.frame: native viewport render, presentation scene at scale 1.0 centred on the player cast origin
scene_configuration.fixtures: arena fill, player marker, hazard markers driven as live victims, HUD bands on a CanvasLayer
scene_configuration.sheet_layout: 3 rows (canonical weapons) x 3 columns (release, active, recovery); each cell is the native frame downscaled by 1/3

measurements.hud_review_bands: top and bottom 0.09 of the frame height; a review convention shared with the Engineer capture spec, not shipped HUD geometry
measurements.hud_band_opaque_ratio: share of review-band pixels an opaque body reaches (channel delta > 0.35 from the arena fill)
measurements.non_arena_coverage_ratio: share of arena pixels the presentation touched at all, translucent backdrop treatment included
measurements.opaque_coverage_ratio: share of arena pixels covered by an opaque body; this is the number to read against the declared max_viewport_coverage_ratio
measurements.player_readable / hazards_readable: marker luminance differs from its own surroundings by at least 0.12
measurements.hue_preserved: the marker still reads in its own colour rather than only as contrast

scope_boundary: Reproducible capture evidence only. Sniper production scenes, VFX, gameplay, balance and adoption data are unchanged.
